LAYOUT.TAGLINE: Monkey is a GRC platform that makes it easier to manage risk, regulatory compliance and audits for companies of all sizes.
LAYOUT.THEME: Switch between light and dark theme

LOGIN.TITLE: Sign in
LOGIN.ERROR_FALLBACK: Could not sign in. Check your credentials.

AUTH.ONLY_MONKEY_TEAM: This application is only for the Monkey team.

MFA.ERROR_FALLBACK: The code could not be verified. Try again.
MFA.VERIFY_HELP: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for Monkey. It changes every 30 seconds.
MFA.USE_APP: Use the code from my app
MFA.RECOVERY_HELP: Enter one of the codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works only once.
MFA.SETUP_INTRO: A code only you see on your phone protects your account.
MFA.SCAN_HELP: In the app choose “Add account” and point it at the code.
MFA.QR_ALT: QR code to add Monkey to your authenticator app
MFA.MANUAL_HELP: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
MFA.CONFIRM_HELP: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
MFA.CODES_HELP: Each code lets you in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
MFA.SAVED: I saved my codes somewhere safe
MFA.CODES_FILE_HEADER: Monkey recovery codes. Each one works only once. Keep them somewhere safe and do not share them.
MFA.QR_REVEAL: Click to show the QR code
MFA.QR_REVEAL_HINT: For security, it is only shown when you ask for it.

ACTIVATE.CODE_HELP: Enter the activation code we emailed you. It works only once.
ACTIVATE.PASSWORD_HELP: Account of {{email}}. Choose a password; next you will set up your second factor.
ACTIVATE.DEAD_HELP: Ask another Monkey administrator to resend your invitation.
ACTIVATE.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not activate the account. Try again.

ERRORS.ACTIVATION_CODE_INVALID: The code is not correct. Check it in the invitation email.
ERRORS.ACTIVATION_CODE_ALREADY_USED: This code was already used to activate an account.
ERRORS.ACTIVATION_CODE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: The code does not belong to this email.
ERRORS.ACTIVATION_CODE_RATE_LIMITED: You made too many attempts with this code.

RESET.TITLE: Create your new password
RESET.HELP: Choose a new password and confirm it is you with the code from your authenticator app.
RESET.DONE_BODY: We signed out all your sessions. Sign in with your new password.
RESET.INVALID_BODY: The link expired, was already used or is not correct. Request a new one and use it within 30 minutes.
RESET.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not change the password. Try again.

FORGOT.TITLE: Recover your password
FORGOT.HELP: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send you a link to create a new password.
FORGOT.SENT_BODY: If the account exists, we sent you a link to create a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes. To finish we will ask for the code from your authenticator app.
FORGOT.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not process the request. Try again.
